title: A CO molecular gas wind 340 pc away from the Seyfert 2 nucleus in ESO 420-G13 probes an elusive radio jet
question: Is there a molecular gas outflow in the Seyfert 2 galaxy ESO 420-G13, and is it driven by a jet, AGN radiation or star formation?

data.bands: Band 6, CO(2-1) plus two ~1.2 mm continuum bands and a CS(5-4) band

what.value: Radio and far-IR fluxes (VLA 1.4 GHz, SUMSS 843 MHz, PACS, SPIRE) from literature and NED

evidence.quote: Flux measurements other than ALMA have been compiled from the literature and the NED database.

what.value: Integrated K-band magnitude 9.51 mag from HyperLeda used for black hole mass

evidence.quote: For an integrated *K* band magnitude of $9.51 \pm 0.08\, \rm{mag}$ taken from the *HyperLeda*[^3] database
we fixed the axis ratio at $b/a = 0.96$ (from NED[^8] based on 2MASS images)

recipe.method: tclean with hogbom, briggs robust 2.0, auto-multithresh, uv continuum subtraction, primary beam correction

recipe.goal: Fit disc rotation for kinematic axes and systemic velocity
recipe.method: DISKFIT chi-square fit of circular rotation only, axis ratio fixed
assumptions: No radial flows or non-circular motions

recipe.goal: Extract wind spectrum and derive mass
recipe.method: 3D mask on cube to isolate outflow; integrate flux; convert to H2 mass with alpha_CO = 0.8

recipe.goal: Compute outflow rate, kinetic luminosity and momentum rate
recipe.method: Mdot = M V/d; Lkin = 1/2 M V^3/d
assumptions: Wind starts at the jet-ISM impact point; values are lower limits due to projection

recipe.goal: Estimate jet power from radio SED and compare with wind
recipe.method: Fit radio-to-IR SED (modified blackbody plus broken power law with cutoff) by chi^2; use f_cav calibration for total mechanical power
assumptions: Synchrotron from nucleus dominates at low frequencies

evidence.quote: The total CO(2–1) intensity integrated in the ALMA map is $260 \pm 2\, \rm{Jy\,\,\hbox{\hbox{km}\,\hbox{s}$^{-1}$}}$
The best-fit model has a *PA* $= 57.8\ensuremath{^\circ} \pm 0.1\ensuremath{^\circ}$ for the kinematic major axis
the depletion time would be of $\eta = M_{\rm tot}/\dot{M} = 23\, \rm{Myr}$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and exact continuum channel ranges for subtraction
Exact definition of the 3D outflow mask
DISKFIT inputs (inclination, centre, radial bins, initial guesses)
How the wind velocity of 160 km/s was averaged from the spectrum
Radio SED fit details (priors, parameters of broken power law and modified blackbody)
Number of execution blocks and calibrators used
score_reason: Imaging parameters mostly given and data likely public, but mask definition, velocity averaging and fit details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Single public ALMA dataset, stated imaging recipe, numeric results (flux, mass, Mdot) can be recomputed.
